name: Scanned QR from an unknown shop

blocks.text: Which card should I pay with?
Category comes from the shop's merchant code (5812, restaurants).

msgs.what: The QR is a upi://pay link carrying payee name, merchant code and sometimes the amount.
The payee name isn't in the merchant registry, so the merchant code decides the category.
With no code and no match the category is 'other', confidence low, and the text says the category is a guess.
